acceptance.exact_head: All research evidence is produced from one exact latest gpt/usdc-audit commit in a freshly created isolated venv.
acceptance.all_ten_fresh: Fresh exact-three-year baseline and stress evidence exists for each of the ten USDC coins with the current V6 profile.
acceptance.history_review: Prior Top-8 candidates, robust finalists, rejects and loss clusters are used to design the next bounded search rather than repeating the same grid blindly.
acceptance.selection_integrity: Candidate ranking uses training windows only. Validation/full windows can reject but cannot introduce or rank a new candidate.
acceptance.robust_coin_improvement: A coin counts as improved only if the challenger is non-regressive versus current in independent validation baseline/stress and full-three-year baseline/stress, improves at least one return measure, and stays within the drawdown gate.
acceptance.search_iteration: Coins with no robust finalist receive a bounded second-stage local search around their prior Top-8 parameter neighborhoods and measured losing-trade regimes. Search must remain finite and reproducible.
acceptance.no_forced_winner: If a coin still has no robust improvement, agents must report that fact and the concrete blocker; they may not weaken gates or reuse validation as training merely to satisfy the owner's target.
acceptance.portfolio_gate: Every robust per-coin finalist is tested one-at-a-time in the canonical saved-max-budget portfolio under baseline and stress costs. Combination testing occurs only after isolated holdout gates.
acceptance.no_auto_promotion: Research does not alter versions.py, Paper state, Live runtime, local WAITING_SIGNAL trial, credentials or active strategy.
acceptance.full_agents: A01-A08 produce specialist evidence; A10 synthesizes and routes unresolved coins; A09 independently QA-checks exact-head evidence; A11 rejects overfit/stale/mixed or automatically promoted results.
acceptance.runtime_recovery: A05 must become fresh and healthy on the preserved Paper ledger after the exact Paper-only strategy activation; no reset and no real/testnet order path.
acceptance.experiment_ledger: A01 must preserve an experiment ledger or immutable current-run summary so previously tested coin configurations and rejection reasons are not silently repeated.
acceptance.eth_counterfactual: A02/A03/A08 must explain ETH momentum19 versus momentum20 at trade and slot-collision level before any new broad ETH grid.
acceptance.candidate_gate: Every serious challenger must report isolated baseline/stress and canonical 250-USDC portfolio baseline/stress plus added/removed/shifted trades, occupied-slot-hour delta and displaced-coin PnL.
acceptance.search_direction: BTC/BNB emphasize capital binding and timing; SOL/LINK/AVAX emphasize opportunity expansion and timing; XRP emphasizes entry timing; DOGE emphasizes volatility reaction; ADA/DOT remain production-frozen shadow research.
acceptance.portfolio_separation: Only after coin profiles are frozen may allocator/ranking research compare 2x125 against alternative equal-250-USDC layouts or opportunity-cost ranking. Coin parameters and allocator rules may not change in the same causal experiment.
acceptance.promotion: A09/A11 reject any promotion without exact-head reproducibility, holdout integrity, base/stress evidence and positive shared-portfolio marginal contribution.
acceptance.promoted_profiles_exact: Canonical V6 must contain AVAX 6/20/8/150/5.2 and DOGE 6/16/14/120/4.3 with DOGE CMO 0.20; all eight other production profiles remain byte-equivalent in behavior.
acceptance.expected_strategy_version: Every strategy identity check must resolve HIXTON-V6-COIN-PAPER-1-c78c8cabf980 and reject stale HIXTON-V6-COIN-PAPER-1-b271d7952d15 as current.
acceptance.fresh_validation: Preflight, exact-three-year dashboard E2E, coin optimization/recheck and A01-A11 must all run on the exact promotion commit; A09 QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS are required before distribution.
acceptance.paper_transition: Persistent Paper history must be preserved while exact owner authorization transitions b271d7952d15 -> c78c8cabf980; no reset and no real/testnet orders.
acceptance.download_identity: The downloadable ZIP must be pinned to the exact validated promotion commit, not merely a moving branch archive.
